basics.name: Dor Tzabari
basics.label: Head of GTM — Building AI-Native GTM Systems
basics.summary: I built and run DriveU.auto's AI-native outbound engine — n8n workflows built node by node, direct REST API integrations, JavaScript in the logic nodes, human-approval gates in Slack, anti-hallucination guardrails, and a live metrics dashboard. It runs live today, at a known cost of about $0.09 per enriched account. What separates me from other builders: I've done the selling myself — 8+ years building go-to-market at early-stage startups; DriveU's first GTM hire, where I founded and ran the entire outbound and RevOps function as a team of one, with a $5M+ ACV global pipeline across US/EMEA/APAC, 10 paid POCs, and 4 multi-year B2B SaaS agreements I sourced and ran myself. The tools I build start from what makes a buyer reply — not from the technology. Previously co-founder & CEO of a smart-city startup and an IDF Yahalom Captain.

work.name: DriveU.auto
work.summary: Provider of teleoperation and autonomy for vehicles, deployed across global autonomous fleets.
highlights: Built and run DriveU's AI outbound engine single-handedly — no spec, no engineering support: seven n8n workflows (120+ nodes) covering the full outbound chain — webhook-triggered enrichment and ICP-scoring runs, contact discovery with scheduled daily enrichment, an outreach generator with per-contact approval previews, a Slack-native corrections loop, and a free-text router that enriches any account on demand from a chat message
Built a live GTM dashboard on the engine's data — a read-only metrics API computing funnel, conversion, velocity, and per-unit-cost metrics — live pipeline visibility for the revenue team

Built the revenue org's data layer through comprehensive market research, before any automation — a proprietary 600+ organization account map of the company's total addressable market that drove the entire pipeline and account strategy, and later the foundation the engine runs on
DriveU's first GTM hire — founded and ran the entire outbound and RevOps function as a team of one; scaled a global pipeline to $5M+ ACV at a 4x coverage ratio across US, EMEA, and APAC
Converted that pipeline into 10 paid POCs and 4 multi-year commercial agreements ($300K–$1.5M ACV each) — deals sourced and run across multi-month, multi-stakeholder cycles
Partnered with CEO, Product, and Engineering to translate enterprise requirements into technical scope and delivery plans for POCs
Cultivated C-level relationships at global events (CES, MWC, Manifest) and established channel partnerships for platform integration and resale
